'''March 2000 Georgia tournament (11 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 11 March 2000. [[Charlie Herren]] won it. It is known from Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d509">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-12-ga-state-championsip-25-march-2000d509/ ga-state-championsip-25-march-2000], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 12 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-12-ga-state-championsip-25-march-2000d509/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 March 2000
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Charlie Herren]]
